evidence.label: SlottedMedal.tsx + SlottedMedalSkin.tsx restored from git (deleted in fa5a01bc)

notes: Bootstrap. The minimal page passes data-testid="slotted-medal-root" since SlottedMedal accepts it as prop. Vite import error resolved: SlottedMedal.tsx and SlottedMedalSkin.tsx were accidentally deleted in commit fa5a01bc and have been restored. tsc --noEmit blind spot: tsconfig.json has 'files':[] and is a project-references composite root — it checks nothing itself; only tsconfig.app.json (used by tsc -p tsconfig.app.json) covers src/, so bare 'tsc --noEmit' silently passes even with broken imports. Fix: use 'npx tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit' in CI.
